purpose: Document the Apple Silicon adaptation and its offline synthetic validation. This profile is not the recommended scientific run; no full model weights have been loaded by the GradDiff integration smoke and no TOFU training has occurred.

device.host: Apple M4 Pro, 48 GB marketed unified-memory capacity; macOS reports 51,539,607,552 bytes (48 GiB)
device.availability_evidence: A three-step synthetic MPS dry run and a CPU-versus-MPS tiny-model loss, gradient, and Torch AdamW update comparison passed outside the restricted command sandbox on 2026-11-03. Inside the sandbox, Metal is hidden. Full-model training has not been tested.
device.estimate_basis: Architecture-based count from the pinned checkpoint config: 16 Llama layers, hidden size 2048, intermediate size 8192, vocabulary 128256, tied embedding/output weights, no projection biases. FP32 parameters plus same-sized gradients plus two FP32 Adam moments is 16 bytes per parameter. Excludes activations, temporary buffers, checkpoint loading copies, allocator overhead, and macOS memory.

estimated_live_tensor_footprints_fp32_ba.notes: Derived tensor sizes, not a peak-memory profile. SDPA may avoid materializing attention scores. The actual MPS backend workspace and activation lifetime are unmeasured.

device.unified_memory_capacity_source: Observed from os.sysconf('SC_PHYS_PAGES') * os.sysconf('SC_PAGE_SIZE'); total capacity, not currently available memory.

device_runtime_overhead_planning_reserve.basis: Explicit planning allowance for macOS, other processes, Metal/PyTorch allocator state, and temporary workspaces; not measured on this host.

estimated_planning_envelope_gib.basis: 18.42 GiB FP32 parameter/gradient/Adam-state floor + about 0.68 GiB of listed live tensors + 8-12 GiB unvalidated device/runtime reserve; on 48 GiB total capacity this leaves 16.9-20.9 GiB for uncounted buffers on paper; excludes other activations and transients.

prototype_implementation.loss_normalization: Shift logits and labels by one token; mean cross entropy over non-ignored next-token labels separately for forget and retain batches; combine the two means with -gamma and +alpha.
prototype_implementation.runtime_safety: Select MPS only when built and available, otherwise CPU for auto; explicit unavailable MPS request errors; no retry after execution failure; WORLD_SIZE must equal 1.
prototype_implementation.claims_limited_to: Synthetic objective, gradient direction, finite-value checks, and AdamW behavior only; no upstream handler or model-scale equivalence claim.

training_adaptations.distributed_launcher: single-process Python; no Accelerate multi-GPU or DeepSpeed ZeRO-3
deviations_from_upstream: FP32 in place of upstream BF16.
PyTorch SDPA in place of flash_attention_2.
Torch AdamW in place of bitsandbytes paged_adamw_32bit; the pinned optimizer has not been tested in this MPS prototype.
One MPS process in place of two CUDA processes and DeepSpeed ZeRO-3.
Microbatch 1 with accumulation 32 to preserve a nominal global batch of 32; order, sampler behavior, kernel numerics, and throughput will still differ from distributed CUDA.

mathematical_equivalence_acceptance_test.reference: OpenUnlearning GradDiff implementation at commit a456aa277be14b836248e42b13b3befe47bb03f4; the deterministic synthetic test transcribes the pinned Transformers causal-LM loss and GradDiff compute_loss arithmetic, but does not execute the upstream class.
completed_local_checks: Tests verify causal shift and mean reduction across non-ignored target tokens, per-split mean-loss coefficients, and gradient contributions -gamma*grad(forget NLL) and +alpha*grad(retain NLL).
A tiny two-task model with AdamW verifies finite losses, gradients, parameters, optimizer state, increasing forget NLL, decreasing retain NLL, and decreasing minimized objective on CPU and MPS.
CPU and MPS tiny-fixture scalar losses, all fixture gradients, and a Torch AdamW parameter update agree within the proposed FP32 tolerances.
A deterministic test-only transcription of the pinned OpenUnlearning compute_loss arithmetic matches local scalar loss and input-logit gradients.
BF16 logits are upcast to FP32 before cross entropy; extreme finite logits produce finite loss and gradients.
remaining_checks: Runtime comparison against the actual pinned OpenUnlearning class with identical causal-model weights has not been run.
Paged AdamW32bit versus torch AdamW and the official optimizer trajectory have not been compared.
Official tokenization, target-label masking, padding, retain sampling, effective-batch aggregation, and model-sized behavior remain unverified.
mathematical_equivalence_acceptance_test.acceptance_rule: All fixed-batch loss, gradient, and update comparisons must pass before considering a full-model MPS pilot. Passing small-model tests establishes objective/update agreement only; it does not establish full-model fit, runtime, deterministic kernels, or benchmark equivalence.
mathematical_equivalence_acceptance_test.execution_status: Task 13: the full repository test suite passed all 39 tests with no skips outside the restricted sandbox; CPU and MPS synthetic CLI dry runs, CPU-versus-MPS tiny-fixture loss/gradient/Torch AdamW update comparisons, and pinned-source equation-transcription checks passed. Task 14: fixture tests and actual cached tokenizer plus checksum-pinned data preparation passed, but full model weights and model forwards were not run. The actual OpenUnlearning class was not executed; no TOFU training, official evaluation, or cloud resource was used.
